svg.aria-label: I’m a final-year Computer Science & Engineering student specializing in Artificial Intelligence at Babu Banarasi Das University, Lucknow. I like taking ideas from notebooks to working software, whether that means preparing a dataset, testing a model, or making a tool someone can actually use. I’m looking for an internship or an early-career team where I can learn by building.
svg.text: Curiosity, with something to show for it.
I’m a final-year Computer Science & Engineering student specializing in
Artificial Intelligence at Babu Banarasi Das University, Lucknow.
I like taking ideas from notebooks to working software, whether that means preparing
a dataset, testing a model, or making a tool someone can actually use. I’m looking for
an internship or an early-career team where I can learn by building.
